meta.title: Payroll System Full Audit Report
meta.auditor: Claude Code - Senior Software Engineer, Payroll System Auditor, Database Analyst, Code Quality Reviewer

executive_summary.overall_quality: MODERATE - Foundation is solid but needs critical fixes
strengths: Modular service structure with singleton pattern
Test suite exists for critical components
Basic audit trail via sync_status and remarks fields
Separation of concerns between data extraction, calculation, and presentation
weaknesses: No transaction handling for multi-statement operations

top_risks.impact: Partial updates leading to data corruption

executive_summary.recommendation: CONDITIONAL PRODUCTION READY - Fix critical bugs (BUG-001, BUG-003) before full deployment

critical_bugs.title: Metadata JSON Total Tidak Sinkron dengan Amount
critical_bugs.dampak: amount di database tidak match dengan total detail di metadata_json
critical_bugs.scenario: User edit PREMI PRUNING via popup, masukkan 3 subblok dengan jumlah 1000, 2000, 1500. Total metadata = 4500. Tapi amount field tidak diupdate otomatis.
critical_bugs.rekomendasi_fix: Ubah fallbackAmount menjadi calculatedTotal di resolveDetailTotalSync function
critical_bugs.evidence: Function resolveDetailTotalSync menggunakan fallbackAmount bukan calculatedTotal untuk amount field

critical_bugs.title: Duplicate Employee Mapping Issue
critical_bugs.dampak: Karyawan salah di-map, payroll goes to wrong person
critical_bugs.status: MITIGATED - DuplicateNikMitigationService exists but needs audit
critical_bugs.rekomendasi_fix: Audit semua flow yang menggunakan employee resolution services

critical_bugs.title: No Transaction on Multi-Statement Operations
critical_bugs.dampak: Partial update jika salah satu statement gagal
critical_bugs.evidence: saveAdjustment uses separate INSERT/UPDATE without transaction wrapper

critical_bugs.title: Frontend-Backend Formula Duplication
critical_bugs.dampak: Potential mismatch antara web report dan print out
critical_bugs.status: PARTIALLY MITIGATED - payrollTotalsCalculator.ts exists in backend
critical_bugs.rekomendasi_fix: Verify payrollTotalsCalculator matches frontend Report.jsx exactly

critical_bugs.title: Hardcoded Database Profile in Queries
critical_bugs.dampak: Query salah database, data tidak konsisten
critical_bugs.rekomendasi_fix: Standardize database profile usage across all services

data_consistency_issues.title: Amount vs Metadata JSON Mismatch
data_consistency_issues.risk: Selisih payroll karena total detail tidak match dengan amount
data_consistency_issues.validation_query: SELECT id, emp_code, amount, JSON_VALUE(metadata_json, '$.total_amount') AS metadata_total FROM extend_db_ptrj.dbo.payroll_manual_adjustments WHERE JSON_VALUE(metadata_json, '$.total_amount') <> amount
data_consistency_issues.fix_approach: Add validation di service layer sebelum save, add trigger di database

data_consistency_issues.title: Duplicate Employee in Same Payroll Period
data_consistency_issues.risk: Double adjustment untuk employee yang sama
data_consistency_issues.validation_query: SELECT period_month, period_year, emp_code, adjustment_name, COUNT(*) FROM extend_db_ptrj.dbo.payroll_manual_adjustments GROUP BY period_month, period_year, emp_code, adjustment_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
data_consistency_issues.fix_approach: Add UNIQUE constraint, improve upsert logic

data_consistency_issues.title: Invalid Metadata JSON Format
data_consistency_issues.risk: Parse error, data tidak bisa diproses
data_consistency_issues.validation_query: SELECT id, emp_code, metadata_json FROM extend_db_ptrj.dbo.payroll_manual_adjustments WHERE TRY_CAST(metadata_json AS JSON) IS NULL
data_consistency_issues.fix_approach: Add JSON validation before save, add CHECK constraint

data_consistency_issues.title: Employee Not in Master Table
data_consistency_issues.validation_query: SELECT DISTINCT ma.emp_code FROM extend_db_ptrj.dbo.payroll_manual_adjustments ma LEFT JOIN db_ptrj.dbo.HR_EMPLOYEE e ON RTRIM(e.EmpCode) = RTRIM(ma.emp_code) WHERE e.EmpCode IS NULL
data_consistency_issues.fix_approach: Add validation before save, add FK constraint

data_consistency_issues.title: Period Cross-Contamination
data_consistency_issues.validation_query: SELECT id, emp_code, period_month, period_year FROM extend_db_ptrj.dbo.payroll_manual_adjustments WHERE period_month < 1 OR period_month > 12 OR period_year < 2000
data_consistency_issues.fix_approach: Add period validation in service layer

code_quality_issues.issue: Too large - single point of failure
Too many routes in single file

code_quality_issues.recommendation: Split into PayrollTable, PayrollCell, PayrollHeader, PayrollToolbar

security_issues.status: LOW RISK - Parameterized queries in use
security_issues.notes: SQL Gateway abstracts direct SQL access, but dynamic LIKE queries should be reviewed
Console.log exposes NIK which is PII. Sanitize logging.

security_issues.status: GOOD - JWT and API key bypass in place
security_issues.notes: Role-based access control exists for ADMIN and KERANI

recommended_architecture.service_pattern: Singleton with repository and validator injection
recommended_architecture.repository_pattern: Data access layer with transaction support
recommended_architecture.validation: Centralized validation service with domain-specific rules
recommended_architecture.calculation_engine: PayrollCalculator as single source of truth
recommended_architecture.error_handling: Centralized error service with structured error codes
recommended_architecture.testing_strategy: Unit tests + Integration tests + E2E tests

actionable_fixes.title: Metadata JSON Sync Validation
actionable_fixes.suggestion: Ubah return value amount dari syncedAmount/fallbackAmount menjadi calculatedTotal
actionable_fixes.patch_code: function resolveDetailTotalSync(...) { ... return { amount: calculatedTotal, metadataJsonStr: JSON.stringify({...metadata, total_amount: calculatedTotal}) }; }

actionable_fixes.title: Add Transaction Wrapper
actionable_fixes.patch_code: await this.db.transaction([{sql: updateSql, params: updateParams}, {sql: insertSql, params: insertParams}]);

actionable_fixes.title: Add Input Validation
actionable_fixes.problem: Tidak ada validasi input sebelum save
actionable_fixes.patch_code: function validateManualAdjustmentInput(data: ManualAdjustment): void { /* period, amount, metadata, emp_code validation */ }

actionable_fixes.title: Sanitize Logging
actionable_fixes.patch_code: console.log('[manual-edit] Incoming payload:', { ..., has_metadata: !!data.metadata_json }); // nik removed
